tools.implementation: literal compatibility alias routes actual IntentRepository/DatabaseTaskSource/VerificationProcessRunner; NEVER instantiate quarantined WorkflowCoordinator
tools.policy: writes require actual gateway confirmation; get_task uses canonical read policy

request_contract.forbidden: caller argv/code/path/SQL/URL/DB/validator/evidence/output; never guess IDs or fall back to CPU inference for fixture actions

response_contract.unwrap: Use actual nested MCP content JSON, reject error/isError/false success; authenticated outer receipt/event still required
response_contract.create: Actual run_id/challenge/objective_id/root_goal_cid/child_goal_cid/task_ids{a,b}; retain graph identity and selected bounded worker
response_contract.dependency: B must remain blocked until A has actual output independently validated and evidence-fenced CAS completion; show named blocker
response_contract.dispatch: Actual task_id/status plus execution producer/validator artifact refs and output_sha256; heartbeat or local button text is not completion
response_contract.get_task: Server-read actual task_id/status/output_sha256; reopening saved UI requires real readback, not cached completed state
response_contract.recovery: Actual timeout/cancel leaves output unpublished and task incomplete, typed supervisor_timeout/supervisor_cancelled; governed retry runs one bounded fresh worker. Re-dispatch of successful task returns same actual record without duplicate worker.
response_contract.cpu: Ordinary submit_task/get_task without fixture_mode retain separate original GPT-2 CPU behavior. Fixture mode never selects arbitrary browser-supplied programs.
response_contract.ui: Inspect real hierarchy/dependencies, preview planned bounded action locally, confirm real governed dispatch, show actual validated output and retained event history; explain unsupported operations honestly. Never label an arbitrary goal as generally executed by this controlled fixture.

scope: Readonly API context; edit only this task's declared app/scenario files. Canonical gateway consent, actual native results, independent receipt+DAG, original semantic workflow, final Grok review and validator remain mandatory. Foundation qualification is not app completion. No caller endpoint/argv/code/path or forged success.
